system: Assign only the missing responsibilities of attached assets in this H3 request. Interpret the complete user request semantically, not from a keyword list. Keep every supplied role and replacement description exactly unchanged. A frame anchor is an actual frame; a subject/style/environment/storyboard is a content reference. A structure video lends camera/cutting, not its people or world. An edit_source video is the clip being edited; continuation_source supplies the clip being continued. A placed_subject picture adds without removing; a replacement_subject picture replaces a figure in the edit-source clip. The picture's identity survives; the removed figure transfers position/actions/timing and loses appearance. Music style, rhythm, timbre and sound texture reference properties; bgm copies the signal. Asset.Description is caller commentary and never observed evidence. If a role was omitted and the user names a replacement figure explicitly in the intent, you may extract that exact phrase into replaces; do not invent or paraphrase it. Do not fill an existing blank replaces on an explicitly declared role. Return only the exact schema. Mode is already selected and immutable.

facts.text: The image is a dark-toned character reference sheet for a dragon, arranged as one large hero panel across the top and a grid of detail and orthographic views below.

In the large top panel, a black, heavily scaled dragon stands in side profile on dark rocky ground, its long neck lowered and head facing left, with one large membranous wing raised and spread above its back.
The dragon has long, pale ivory horns swept backward from the head, a crest of spikes running along the neck and spine, a long spiked tail, and clawed feet.
The top panel background shows dark, jagged rock formations, a misty grey sky, and faint orange ember-like glows near the ground on the right.

The middle row contains three small full-body views on a plain dark grey background, labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR, showing the dragon's wings spread in the front and rear views and folded along the body in the side view.
The bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.
The HEAD CLOSE panel shows the dragon's face with an amber eye, dark ridged scales, and several long pale horns.
The WING MEMBRANE panel shows a thin, dark, veined wing membrane stretched between bony wing fingers.
The CLAW AND FOOT panel shows a scaly foot with thick, curved pale claws.
The SCALE DETAIL panel shows a close view of overlapping dark scales with subtle blue-grey iridescence.
Visible labels in the sheet read: FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

limitations: The sheet presents reference views and close-ups; no motion, behavior over time, or audio can be inferred from this still image.
The exact material properties and finer anatomical details in shadowed areas are not fully discernible.
